import bpy, subprocess, shutil
from pathlib import Path

EXPECTED_LOCAL = Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend')
current = Path(bpy.data.filepath) if bpy.data.filepath else None
if current is None or current.resolve() != EXPECTED_LOCAL.resolve():
    raise RuntimeError(f'SAFETY_STOP: arquivo atual inesperado: {bpy.data.filepath!r}')

repo_url = 'https://github.com/washingtonmsdj/projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda.git'
vendor_root = Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor')
repo_dir = vendor_root / 'projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda'
vendor_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def run_git(args):
    p = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'git failed: {args}\nstdout={p.stdout}\nstderr={p.stderr}')
    return p.stdout.strip()

if not (repo_dir / '.git').exists():
    if repo_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(repo_dir)
    run_git(['git', 'clone', '--depth', '1', '--branch', 'main', repo_url, str(repo_dir)])
else:
    run_git(['git', '-C', str(repo_dir), 'fetch', 'origin', 'main'])
    run_git(['git', '-C', str(repo_dir), 'checkout', 'main'])
    run_git(['git', '-C', str(repo_dir), 'pull', '--ff-only', 'origin', 'main'])

commit = run_git(['git', '-C', str(repo_dir), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
source_blend = repo_dir / 'blender' / 'salvador_lacerda_oficial.blend'
if not source_blend.exists():
    raise RuntimeError(f'Arquivo fonte nao encontrado: {source_blend}')

MASTER = 'IMPORT_GITHUB_OFICIAL'
old_master = bpy.data.collections.get(MASTER)
if old_master:
    def purge_collection(c):
        for child in list(c.children):
            purge_collection(child)
        for obj in list(c.objects):
            bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if c.name in bpy.data.collections:
            bpy.data.collections.remove(c)
    purge_collection(old_master)

master = bpy.data.collections.new(MASTER)
bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(master)

source_scene_name = 'SALVADOR | ESBOCO OFICIAL'
with bpy.data.libraries.load(str(source_blend), link=False) as (data_from, data_to):
    if source_scene_name not in data_from.scenes:
        raise RuntimeError(f'Cena fonte nao encontrada. Disponiveis: {list(data_from.scenes)}')
    data_to.scenes = [source_scene_name]

loaded_scene = next((s for s in bpy.data.scenes if s.name == source_scene_name and s != bpy.context.scene), None)
if loaded_scene is None:
    # Blender pode renomear em caso de conflito; pegar a cena recem-carregada pelo conjunto de colecoes conhecido
    candidates = [s for s in bpy.data.scenes if s != bpy.context.scene]
    if not candidates:
        raise RuntimeError('Cena oficial foi carregada mas nao foi localizada')
    loaded_scene = candidates[-1]

imported_top = []
for child in list(loaded_scene.collection.children):
    loaded_scene.collection.children.unlink(child)
    master.children.link(child)
    imported_top.append(child.name)

root_objects = list(loaded_scene.collection.objects)
for obj in root_objects:
    loaded_scene.collection.objects.unlink(obj)
    master.objects.link(obj)

# Remover apenas o datablock da cena temporaria; dados importados continuam em nossa colecao master.
bpy.data.scenes.remove(loaded_scene)

master['source_repo'] = repo_url
master['source_commit'] = commit
master['source_blend'] = str(source_blend)
master['import_mode'] = 'APPEND_ISOLATED_MASTER_COLLECTION'

# Nao altera nem remove Lacerda_Do_Zero. Apenas enquadra o conteúdo oficial importado.
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
imported_objects = list(master.all_objects)
for obj in imported_objects:
    try:
        obj.hide_set(False)
        obj.select_set(True)
    except Exception:
        pass
if imported_objects:
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = imported_objects[0]

framed = 0
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    for area in window.screen.areas:
        if area.type != 'VIEW_3D':
            continue
        region = next((r for r in area.regions if r.type == 'WINDOW'), None)
        if region:
            with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window, screen=window.screen, area=area, region=region):
                bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
            area.tag_redraw()
            framed += 1

print('IMPORT_OK')
print(f'SOURCE_COMMIT={commit}')
print(f'TOP_COLLECTIONS={imported_top}')
print(f'ROOT_OBJECTS={len(root_objects)}')
print(f'IMPORTED_OBJECTS={len(imported_objects)}')
print(f'CURRENT_LOCAL={bpy.data.filepath}')
print(f'FRAMED={framed}')
